ios.desc:
Pocket Casts is the world's most powerful podcast platform, an app by listeners, for listeners. Our podcast player provides next-level listening, search and discovery tools. Find your next obsession with our hand-curated podcast recommendations for easy discovery, and seamlessly enjoy your favorite shows without the hassle of subscribing.

Here's what the press has to say:
 • Wired: "Pocket Casts Is the Podcast App Every iPhone User Needs"
 • iMore: "Pocket Casts is the best podcast app for iPhone"

PLAYLISTS
Your listening, your way. Organize your episodes with our powerful Playlists feature:
- Playlists: Curate your perfect mix. Combine episodes from different podcasts, build collections around specific themes or guests, and even add episodes from podcasts you don't follow.
- Smart Playlists: We’ve upgraded our famous Filters. Build lists that automatically update based on rules you set, like release date, duration, or download status.

WE SWEAT THE DETAILS
 • Design: Easily listen to, manage and find new podcasts.
 • Themes: Dark, light, and an Extra Dark theme for those of you on OLED screens.
 • Universal: Custom but familiar iPad interface, supporting Slide Over, Split View and Picture in Picture.
 • Everywhere: CarPlay, AirPlay, Chromecast and Sonos. Listen to your podcasts in more places than ever before.

POWERFUL PLAYBACK
 • Up next: Automatically build a playback queue from your favorite shows. Sign in and have that Up Next queue sync to all your devices.
 • Trim silence: Cut silences from episodes so you finish them faster, saving hours.
 • Variable speed: Change the play speed from anywhere between 0.5 to 3x.
 • Volume boost: Increase the volume of voices, while decreasing background noise.
 • Stream: Play episodes on the fly.
 • Chapters: Jump between chapters easily, and enjoy embedded artwork that the author has added (we support MP3 and M4A chapter formats).
 • Audio & video: Play all of your favorite episodes, toggle video to audio.
 • Skip playback: Skip episode intros, jump through episodes with custom skip intervals.
 • Apple Watch: Control playback, volume and effects from our Apple Watch app, without ever touching your phone.
 • Sleep timer: We'll pause your episode so you can rest your weary head.

SMART TOOLS
 • Sync: Subscriptions, Up Next, listening history, playback and filters are all securely stored in the cloud. You can pick up where you left off on another device and even the web.
 • Refresh: Let our servers check for new ep

android.desc:
Pocket Casts is the world's most powerful free podcast app, made by listeners, for listeners 🎧. Our free podcast player makes it easy to listen, discover, and enjoy podcasts your way. Stream podcasts, trending shows, and audiobooks all in one powerful audio app. Are you a podcast addict? Find new shows with our curated podcast recommendations and enjoy personalized podcast recommendations for every mood. Catch the latest podcast episodes and manage your library with our smart app for listening to podcasts features.

🌟 BEST PODCAST APP EXPERIENCE 🌟
* Material design - Beautiful, intuitive interface with themes including Extra Dark for OLED screens
* Everywhere you listen - Android Auto, Chromecast, Alexa, Wear OS, and Sonos
* Playlists & Smart Playlists - Combine episodes from different podcasts, create custom rules, and keep your listening organized
* All-in-one audio player for podcasts and audiobooks with seamless playback

🔊 POWERFUL PLAYBACK 🔊
* Offline podcast player - Listen anywhere, even without internet
* Trim silence & variable speed - Save time while enjoying every episode
* Sleep timer - Automatically stop playback after a set time
* Cross-platform podcast support - Your subscriptions, history, and playlists sync across devices
* Enjoy audiobooks and apple podcasts with smooth streaming and offline listening

🧠 SMART TOOLS 🧠
* Auto download and cloud sync
* Notifications for new episodes
* Advanced smart podcast player features for filtering and sorting
* Find exactly what you want with the app’s lightning fast podcast search

❤️ ALL YOUR FAVORITES ❤️
* Subscribe on iTunes and beyond using our podcast app for iphone or Android version
* Share episodes or collections with friends
* Import or export your library effortlessly
* Enjoy your pocket casts podcast collection seamlessly

🏆 LOVED BY THE PRESS 🏆
* Android Central: “Pocket Casts is the best podcasts app for Android”
* The Verge: “The best podcast player for Android”
* Google Play Top Developer, Editors’ Choice, Material Design Award recipient
* Explore audiobooks, and discover new audio content anytime, anywhere.

Whether it’s your daily commute, a workout, or relaxing at home, Pocket Casts is the ultimate podcast player app. Download now and get your favorite shows, the latest podcast episodes, and expert podcast app recommendations all in one place 🎉
